## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks and fan design audit

Raw signed Rxx and drain current precede the spectra below. Both runs are complete; drain current stays 9.81–9.94 nA, sample T 1.165–1.292 K, gate currents below 0.216 nA, and |Rxx| below 587 ohm against 5 kohm full scale. Negative signed Rxx excursions are retained; only positive B was acquired, so Hall admixture has not been removed.

Electron run 6 at n_A=3.2, D_A≈0 has candidate tones near 7.1, 14.1, 22.1 and 29.5 T; the harmonic labels are hypotheses, not pocket assignments. Full-range polynomial detrending produces censored low-frequency onset tracks. Restricting the onset fit to B≤4–5 T avoids the large 8–10 T MR bend and gives the light candidate onset near 1.02–1.04 T (degree 5); degree 3 weakens that track. Adopt the computed B≤5 T result as a **qualified design onset**, not a measured absence below it. The 22 T track turns on around 1.3–1.4 T and the 29.5 T track around 1.73 T. This background sensitivity remains an analysis limitation.

Hole run 7 at n_A=−1.2 has onset 0.714 T, but the forward model gives ABAB 5.86/6.54 T: separation 0.68 T is below 2δF≈1.54 T even using the full 10 T record. Choose the electron fan for a cross-density trajectory check. At n_A=2.8–3.2, the model gives ABAB 6.04–7.31 and 22.91–25.78 T, versus ABCA F_L=28.95–33.09 T; the adjacent-N ABA overlay is distinct and must be checked after the fan. The overlay below is a design comparison at scale 1, **not a fitted classification**. A single global scale must eventually fit the whole peak set.

**Current verdict — sr1, B_1–B_2: stacking uninformative.** Harmonics, breakdown/mixing and the two CNP ridges remain confounded at one electron density. Region A coordinates use run 5; the second ridge's offset and slightly different slope mean region B cannot be assigned the same density or D without a separate calibration. No independent region B call, no singleton/domain claim, and no absolute layer-number validation yet. The fan advances frequency trajectories; grid-change reproduction, window stability, whole-set Luttinger/model comparison and, if needed, LK mass splitting remain before a strong call.

from pathlib import Path
import json
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import open_run, resolve_channels, plot_raw, sdh_onset, sdh_fft, SdhOnsetError, summarize_run
out = {}
for rid in (6,7):
 r=open_run(Path('data')/str(rid)); print(summarize_run(r))
 ch={c.cid:c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
 I=r.col('sr0_X')/ch['sr0'].gain
 R=(r.col('sr1_X')/ch['sr1'].gain)/I
 B=r.col('magnet_field'); ix=np.argsort(B); B,R=B[ix],R[ix]
 fig=plot_raw(r); plt.savefig(f'hera_scratch/spot_{rid}_raw.png'); plt.show()
 dt=np.diff(r.col('time')); db=np.abs(np.diff(r.col('magnet_field')))
 print('QUALITY',rid,'R range',R.min(),R.max(),'I nA',I.min()*1e9,I.max()*1e9,'T',np.min(r.col('T_sample')),np.max(r.col('T_sample')),'leak pA',[(c,float(np.max(np.abs(r.col(c))))*1e12) for c in ('k_2400_tg_curr','k_2400_bg_curr')])
 print('TIMING seconds', np.sum(dt), 'step median', np.median(dt),'over bare ramp median',np.median(dt-db*438))
 try:
  on=sdh_onset(R,B,r_full_scale=5000); print(on.summary())
 except SdhOnsetError as e:
  print('ONSET ERROR',e); continue
 out[rid]={'onset':on.onset_b,'tones':[{'freq':t.freq,'onset':t.onset_b,'censored':bool(t.censored)} for t in on.tones]}
 fig,axs=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(10,7))
 axs[0].plot(B,R); axs[0].axvline(on.onset_b,color='r'); axs[0].set(xlabel='B (T)',ylabel='Rxx (ohm)')
 for lo in sorted(set([on.onset_b,1.,1.5,2.,3.])):
  for degree in (3,5,7):
   f,sp=sdh_fft(R[:,None],B,b_range=(lo,10),bg_degree=degree,log=False,nfft=4096)
   pk,_=find_peaks(sp[0]); pk=sorted([p for p in pk if 3<f[p]<60],key=lambda p:-sp[0,p])[:6]
   print('FFT',rid,'lo',round(lo,3),'degree',degree,'peaks',[(round(float(f[p]),2),round(float(sp[0,p]),2)) for p in pk])
   if degree==5: axs[1].plot(f,sp[0],label=f'B>{lo:.2f}')
 axs[1].set(xlim=(0,60),xlabel='frequency (T)',ylabel='FFT amplitude'); axs[1].legend(); fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(f'hera_scratch/spot_{rid}_fft.png'); plt.show()
json.dump(out,open('hera_scratch/spot_results.json','w'),indent=2)
# Local-background onset audit: avoid the large 8-10 T MR bend driving
# the low-field polynomial residual. Keep the full-window result above.
r=open_run('data/6'); ch={c.cid:c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
B=r.col('magnet_field'); R=(r.col('sr1_X')/ch['sr1'].gain)/(r.col('sr0_X')/ch['sr0'].gain)
for hi in (3.,4.,5.):
 for deg in (3,5):
  local=sdh_onset(R,B,b_lo=.3,b_hi=hi,bg_degree=deg,r_full_scale=5000)
  print(f'LOCAL ONSET AUDIT B<= {hi}, degree {deg}:\n{local.summary()}')
local=sdh_onset(R,B,b_lo=.3,b_hi=5,bg_degree=5,r_full_scale=5000)
json.dump({'B_lo':local.onset_b,'B_hi_fit':5.,'degree':5,'run':6,'qualification':'local-background design onset; full-range fit is censored and detrend-sensitive'},open('hera_scratch/fan_onset.json','w'),indent=2)
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.home()/'measurement_env/hera/models/tetralayer_fs_count'))
from fs_count_b0 import abab_fs,bernal_fs,ABA_TRI
ns=np.linspace(2.8,3.2,21)
ab=np.array([[q[0] for q in abab_fs(n*1e16)[1]] for n in ns])
tri=np.array([[q[0] for q in bernal_fs(n*1e16,seq='ABA',p=ABA_TRI)[1]] for n in ns])
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8,5))
for j in range(2):
 ax.plot(ns,ab[:,j],color='C0',label='ABAB model' if j==0 else None)
 ax.plot(ns,tri[:,j],'--',color='C1',label='ABA adjacent-N model' if j==0 else None)
ax.plot(ns,10.33916924*ns,color='C2',label='ABCA / Luttinger g=4')
ax.scatter([3.2]*4,[7.1,14.1,22.1,29.5],color='k',marker='x',label='run 6 candidate tones, not assigned')
ax.set(xlabel='n_A (10^12 cm^-2), geometry scale',ylabel='F (T)',title='Fan design: candidate tones vs model branches (scale 1, not a fit)'); ax.legend(); fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig('hera_scratch/fan_design_overlay.png'); plt.show()

## HERA — Electron D≈0 Landau fan for the stacking trajectory test

> **05:25** · Electron D\_A=0 fan: n\_A 3.2->2.8e12 cm^-2, B 1.017618->6.5 T, uniform 1/B 151x11, base T, Si=0, 10nA, 3s dwell, sr1 50uV · **ETA ~08:10** (≈2h45m)

**Decision and arc.** Gates A/B are green (setup and SAFETIES measure cells 2–27; VERIFY cell 32); Gate C passed in runs 0–3. The operator's state0 replay and bound-kernel probe are measure cells 44/46; the recorded E1 grant remains engaged. Runs 5–7 and ana cells 12–15 now support Step 4 of `investigations/tetralayer-stacking-fs-count`: one `landau-fan-vti` on the electron side, with raw per-channel maps before FFT/model interpretation. This is a cross-density test of the 7/14/22/30 T candidates and their harmonic/sum relations, not a stacking assignment from their amplitudes.

**Coordinates and coverage.** Use run-5 region-A calibration c_tg=0.0027960593, c_bg=0.0021606965 F/m², n_offset=−0.0893793×10¹² cm⁻² and D_offset=−0.013 V/nm. Ratio is map-calibrated; absolute density retains its geometry prior. Sweep n_A=3.2→2.8×10¹² cm⁻² at D_A=0, 11 paired gate points (TG 0.98359→0.86899 V; BG 1.16628→1.01798 V), Si=0, fixed hardwired sr1 B_1−B_2. The second CNP ridge is unresolved spatially and has a different offset/slope: its coordinates are not silently assigned those of A. Exclude lower electron densities and holes: the model's small pocket loses the five-period budget there, and at the available hole limit the predicted ABAB pair is too close to resolve. Extending to the entire allowed D=0 line with the same acquisition quality would cost roughly 18 h and would still not resolve every low-density pocket. This fan only supports a call over the measured electron interval and this contact pair.

**Onset qualification.** `sdh_onset` on run 6 with B≤5 T, b_lo=0.3 T, degree-5 B-space detrending gives B_lo=1.01761788 T, carried by the ~6.8 T component. The B≤4 T fit gives 1.03 T; a degree-3 fit weakens that component, and full-range fits are censored/background-sensitive because of the large 8–10 T MR bend (ana cell 15 shows the audit). Adopt the local result for this bounded fan; do not claim that oscillations are absent below B_lo or that an unresolved partner is absent. Run 7's 0.714 T onset cannot compensate for its closely spaced hole-side model tones.

**Resolution and cost floor.** B ascends from 1.01761788 to **6.5 T**, uniform in 1/B, **151 rows × 11 density points = 1661 samples**. At n=2.8 the model ABAB tones are 6.038/22.914 T; at 3.2 they are 7.306/25.783 T. ABCA F_L=28.950–33.089 T. The 1/B span is 0.828841 T⁻¹, δF=1.2065 T; the lightest nominal ABAB pocket has 5.004 periods and the heavy-vs-singleton split exceeds 2δF. Five periods are nominal-scale: a later global scale correction changes this claim. Nyquist: Δ(1/B)=0.00552561 T⁻¹, f_N=90.49 T, clearing a conservative 89.98 T guard that includes 20% scale allowance, the second ridge's approximate density offset, and the observed second harmonic near 59 T. Δn=0.04×10¹²; even multiplied by 1.2 it is below half the g=4 ray spacing at B_lo (0.04921×10¹²). These are the integer point-count floors for the declared window/guard. 6.5 T is the smallest rounded endpoint that gives five nominal light-pocket periods; no 10 T extension is warranted by this target. The uniform-inverse-B grid also changes the run-6 sampling scheme for the alias check.

**Acquisition and headroom.** Keep τ=0.3 s and 24 dB/oct on sr0/sr1; fast dwell=3 s=10τ (the spot-check driver settle), slow_delay=1 s in addition to the blocking field ramp/3 s driver settle. Fixed sr1=50 µV gives 5 kohm FS at 10 nA. The measured run-6 peak is 530 ohm through 10 T; multiplying by 3.2/2.8 and a further 2× low-density MR allowance gives ~1.21 kohm, leaving >4× headroom. This is an estimate, with a 90%-FS stop guard. Record and plot both temperatures, both gate currents and both active lock-ins' X/P; n.c. sr2/sr3 carry no region evidence.

**Wall-clock basis.** Run 5 median gate-point time was 1.0985 s at 1 s dwell (NPLC=1); use 3.16 s/point for two co-swept gates and the second file thermometer. Runs 6/7 measured ~3.08 s/field step above the 438 s/T bare ramp. Budget 1661×3.16 s=87.5 min, 151×5 s=12.6 min for driver settle/slow dwell/flyback/readback, and 6.5×7.3=47.45 min for the entire 0→6.5 T ramp including initial positioning. Add startup and 10% contingency: ~163 min, rounded to 2 h 45 min. No Si move, heater change, gate-step change or safety-surface change. End at 6.5 T and n_A=2.8 for analysis; any later field move is priced separately.

**Preflight and checkpoints.** Before any write, read/assert all seven validators and both caps against the card, current base-T/fresh logfiles, heaters off, actual |B|<0.05 T, PS/output on, Si range/output/0 V, pacing, NPLC, drive, τ/filter and hardwired roles. Read actual B on each row; gate-current >1 nA, nonfinite data, loss of base T, drain outside 8–12 nA, stale thermometry or near-rail stops the sweep. The armed `hera-watch data --next --follow` is the completion authority. Check the first three complete rows for signal/current/rails/temperature and row timing; then every ~30 min and at B≈3 T and 5 T evaluate landed-row digests and whether a useful dispersing pattern is developing.
